annotations.title: Read the comments under a Reddit post

description: The comments of one Reddit post, flattened in thread order (a reply follows its parent; parentId and depth rebuild the tree), each with author, text, upvotes, time and link, plus the post itself. Deleted and removed comments come through as Reddit shows them. Pass the post's link (from reddit_subreddit_feed, search_reddit or a browser); `cursor` reads the next batch of a long thread. A goldmine for the exact words customers use. Spends about a credit per call.

cursor.description: the more-comments token a previous call returned

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice
